source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Unit 2 (PDF 27-38), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 2 (Functions and Graphs) ke poore unit se practice MCQs hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah, jis mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The term function was introduced by the mathematician:
(Lafz function kis mathematician ne mutaarif karaya?)
blocks.explanation: Unit ke mutabiq German mathematician Leibniz (1646-1716) ne lafz function mutaarif karaya.

book_ref.quote: The term function was introduced by the German mathematician Leibniz

blocks.prompt:
2 The volume of a sphere is \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3}\). For \(r = 6\), \(V =\)
(Sphere (kurra) ka volume \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3}\) hai. \(r = 6\) ke liye \(V\) kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi(6)^{3} = \frac{4}{3}\pi(216) = 288\pi\); aik radius ka aik hi volume.

book_ref.quote: of a sphere depends on its radius

blocks.prompt:
3 Which of the following is NOT allowed for a function?
(Function mein in mein se kya ijazat NAHI?)

options.text: do inputs ka aik hi output
doosre set ke kuch elements istemal na hon
har input ka bilkul aik output

blocks.explanation: Pehle set ka har element sirf aur sirf aik element se jura ho; do inputs ka aik output ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: each element in the first set corresponds to one and only one element in the second set

blocks.prompt:
4 For a function \(f : X \to Y\), the set \(X\) is called the:
(Function \(f : X \to Y\) mein set \(X\) kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Inputs ka set \(X\), \(f\) ka domain hai; \(Y\) co-domain hai.

book_ref.quote: The set \(X\) is called the domain of \(f\).

blocks.explanation: \(f(1) = 2\), \(f(2) = 4\), \(f(3) = 6\); range sirf woh outputs hain jo waqai aate hain, \(\{2, 4, 6\} \subseteq Y\).

book_ref.quote: The set of corresponding elements

blocks.prompt:
6 The range of a function is always:
(Function ki range hamesha:)
blocks.explanation: Range asal outputs ka set hai, is liye hamesha co-domain ka subset hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: So the range is always a subset of the co-domain.

blocks.prompt:
7 Which rule from \(X = \{1, 2, 3\}\) to \(Y = \{p, q\}\) is a function?
(\(X = \{1, 2, 3\}\) se \(Y = \{p, q\}\) tak kaunsa rule function hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(X\) ke har element ka bilkul aik image ho. Sirf pehla rule aisa hai; baqi mein koi input reh jata hai ya \(1\) ke do images hain.

book_ref.quote: is a rule or a correspondence that assigns to each element

blocks.text: 2.1.2 Notation and Value of a Function

blocks.prompt:
8 The notation \(y = f(x)\) was invented by:
(Alamat \(y = f(x)\) kis ne ijaad ki?)
blocks.explanation: Swiss mathematician Euler (1707-1783) ne \"\(y\), \(x\) ka function hai\" ko \(y = f(x)\) likha.

book_ref.quote: invented a symbolic way to write the statement

blocks.prompt:
9 In \(y = f(x)\), the variable \(x\) is called the:
(\(y = f(x)\) mein variable \(x\) kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x\) independent variable hai (hum chunte hain); \(y\) dependent variable hai.

book_ref.quote: is called the independent variable of
is called the value of \(f\) at \(x\)

blocks.prompt:
11 If \(f(x) = 2x - 5\), then \(f(a + 2) =\)
(Agar \(f(x) = 2x - 5\) ho to \(f(a + 2)\) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: the image of \(x\) under \(f\)

blocks.prompt:
12 If \(f(x) = x^{2} + 1\), then \(f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)\), \(x \ne 0\), is:
(Agar \(f(x) = x^{2} + 1\) ho to \(f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)\), \(x \ne 0\), kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: takes an input \(x\), operates on it in some way and produces exactly one output

blocks.prompt:
13 The domain of \(f(x) = \frac{1}{x - 3}\) is:
(\(f(x) = \frac{1}{x - 3}\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Denominator \(x - 3 = 0\) jab \(x = 3\); wahan \(f\) defined nahi; baqi har real \(x\) theek hai.

book_ref.quote: Find the domain and range of \(f(x) = \dfrac{x}{x^{2} - 4}\).

blocks.prompt:
14 The domain of \(f(x) = \frac{x + 1}{x^{2} - 25}\) is:
(\(f(x) = \frac{x + 1}{x^{2} - 25}\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} - 25 = 0 \Rightarrow x = \pm 5\); inhein nikal dein. (\(x = -1\) par sirf \(f = 0\) hota hai, jo jaiz hai.)

book_ref.quote: Domain: where is the denominator zero?

blocks.prompt:
15 The domain of \(f(x) = \sqrt{x - 4}\) is:
(\(f(x) = \sqrt{x - 4}\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x - 4 \ge 0\) chahiye, yani \(x \ge 4\); \(x = 4\) par \(\sqrt{0} = 0\), is liye kinara shamil.

book_ref.quote: Condition for a real square root

blocks.prompt:
16 The range of \(f(x) = x^{2} + 3\), \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), is:
(\(f(x) = x^{2} + 3\), \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), ki range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} \ge 0 \Rightarrow x^{2} + 3 \ge 3\), aur \(3 = f(0)\); har \(y \ge 3\), \(x = \sqrt{y - 3}\) se milta hai.

book_ref.quote: Find the domain and range of \(f(x) = x^{2}\).

blocks.prompt:
17 The domain of \(f(x) = \sqrt{16 - x^{2}}\) is:
(\(f(x) = \sqrt{16 - x^{2}}\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(16 - x^{2} \ge 0\) chahiye. Critical points \(\pm 4\); \(x = 0\) par True, \(x = \pm 5\) par False; kinare shamil.

book_ref.quote: Find the domain and range of \(f(x) = \sqrt{x^{2} - 9}\).

blocks.prompt:
18 The set of all \(x\) with \(-2 \le x < 5\) is written as:
(Tamam \(x\) jin ke liye \(-2 \le x < 5\), kaise likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(-2\) shamil hai (square bracket), \(5\) nahi (round bracket).

book_ref.quote: In a closed interval \([a, b]\) the endpoints are included.

blocks.prompt:
19 The range of \(f(x) = -x^{2}\), \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), is:
(\(f(x) = -x^{2}\), \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), ki range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} \ge 0 \Rightarrow -x^{2} \le 0\); \(0 = f(0)\) milta hai aur har \(y \le 0\), \(x = \sqrt{-y}\) se.

book_ref.quote: Every real number can be squared

blocks.prompt:
20 By the vertical line test, a graph represents a function if and only if:
(Vertical line test ke mutabiq graph function tab hi hai jab:)

options.text: koi horizontal line graph ko aik se zyada dafa na kaate
har vertical line graph ko do dafa kaate
koi vertical line graph ko aik se zyada dafa na kaate

blocks.explanation: Graph function tab hi hai jab koi vertical line use aik se zyada dafa na kaate.

book_ref.quote: A graph represents a function if and only if no vertical line intersects the graph more than once.

blocks.prompt:
21 Which of these graphs is NOT the graph of a function of \(x\)?
(In mein se kaunsa graph \(x\) ka function NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: Line \(x = 0\) circle ko \((0, 4)\) aur \((0, -4)\) par kaatti hai: aik input, do outputs.

book_ref.quote: If any vertical line passes through the graph more than once, it is not a function.

blocks.prompt:
22 The vertical line \(x = 1\) meets the circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 10\) at:
(Vertical line \(x = 1\) circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 10\) ko kahan kaatti hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(1 + y^{2} = 10 \Rightarrow y^{2} = 9 \Rightarrow y = \pm 3\): do nuqte, is liye circle \(x\) ka function nahi.

book_ref.quote: The vertical line test is a method used to determine whether a graph represents a function.

blocks.prompt:
23 A function \(f\) is one-to-one if:
(Function \(f\) one-to-one kab hai?)

options.text: co-domain ke har element ka pre-image ho

blocks.explanation: One-to-one: mukhtalif inputs ke mukhtalif outputs, yani \(f(x_{1}) = f(x_{2}) \Rightarrow x_{1} = x_{2}\).

book_ref.quote: A function \(f\) is one-to-one if different inputs produce different outputs

blocks.prompt:
24 Which function \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\) is one-to-one?
(Kaunsa function \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\) one-to-one hai?)

book_ref.quote: This means that no two different elements of the domain map to the same element of the co-domain.

blocks.prompt:
25 For \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = 3x - 6\), the pre-image of \(9\) is:
(\(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = 3x - 6\) mein \(9\) ka pre-image kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(3x - 6 = 9 \Rightarrow x = 5\); jaanch \(f(5) = 9\).

book_ref.quote: has at least one pre-image in the domain

blocks.prompt:
26 \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = x^{2} + 1\) is not onto, because which element of the co-domain has no pre-image?
(\(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = x^{2} + 1\) onto nahi, kyunke co-domain ke kis element ka pre-image nahi?)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} + 1 = 0 \Rightarrow x^{2} = -1\): koi real root nahi. (\(1, 2, 5\), \(x = 0, \pm 1, \pm 2\) se milte hain.)

book_ref.quote: for every \(y\) in \(Y\), there exists an \(x\) in \(X\) such that

blocks.prompt:
27 A function is called bijective if it is:
(Function bijective kab kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bijective \(=\) one-to-one aur onto dono.

book_ref.quote: is called bijective if it is both one-to-one and onto.

blocks.prompt:
28 The function \(f(x) = x^{2}\) from \(\mathbb{R}\) to \([0, \infty)\) is:
(Function \(f(x) = x^{2}\), \(\mathbb{R}\) se \([0, \infty)\) tak, kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har \(y \ge 0\) ka pre-image \(\sqrt{y}\) (onto), magar \(f(2) = f(-2) = 4\) (one-to-one nahi).

book_ref.quote: if every element in the co-domain

blocks.prompt:
29 If \(f(x) = 3x - 1\) for \(x < 1\) and \(f(x) = x^{2} + 2\) for \(x \ge 1\), then \(f(1) =\)
(Agar \(x < 1\) par \(f(x) = 3x - 1\) aur \(x \ge 1\) par \(f(x) = x^{2} + 2\) ho to \(f(1)\) kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(1 \ge 1\), is liye doosra hissa: \(f(1) = 1^{2} + 2 = 3\). (\(2\) ghalat hisse se aata hai.)

book_ref.quote: A piecewise function is a function that is defined by different expressions
Each piece applies to a specific part of the domain.

blocks.prompt:
31 For \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = x^{2} - 5\), the range is:
(\(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = x^{2} - 5\) ki range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} \ge 0 \Rightarrow x^{2} - 5 \ge -5\), \(x = 0\) par; is liye \(f\), \(\mathbb{R}\) par onto nahi.

book_ref.quote: Show that the function \(f(x) = x^{2} - 2\), where the domain and co-domain are all real numbers, is neither one-to-one nor onto.

blocks.prompt:
32 Which pair of inputs shows that \(f(x) = x^{2} + 4\) is not one-to-one?
(Kaunsa inputs ka joda dikhata hai ke \(f(x) = x^{2} + 4\) one-to-one nahi?)
blocks.explanation: \(f(3) = f(-3) = 13\): do mukhtalif inputs, aik output.

book_ref.quote: Show that the function \(f(x) = x + 1\), where the domain and co-domain are all real numbers, is bijective.

blocks.prompt:
33 The point of intersection of the graphs of two functions represents:
(Do functions ke graphs ka nuqta-e-taqatu kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono graphs par wala nuqta dono equations ko poora karta hai, is liye system ka hal hai.

book_ref.quote: This point represents the solution(s) to the equations of the given functions.

blocks.text: 2.2.1 Intersection of a Linear Function and Coordinate Axes

blocks.prompt:
34 The line \(y = 3x - 12\) meets the \(x\)-axis at:
(Line \(y = 3x - 12\), \(x\)-axis ko kahan kaatti hai?)

book_ref.quote: Find the points of intersection of a linear function

blocks.prompt:
35 The line \(y = -4x + 7\) meets the \(y\)-axis at:
(Line \(y = -4x + 7\), \(y\)-axis ko kahan kaatti hai?)

book_ref.quote: While the coordinate axes refers to

blocks.prompt:
36 Which of these is a linear function?
(In mein se kaunsa linear function hai?)
blocks.explanation: Linear function mein variable ki sab se bari power aik hoti hai: \(5 - 2x\).

book_ref.quote: linear function is a function in which the highest power of the variable is one

blocks.prompt:
37 The lines \(y = 2x + 1\) and \(y = -x + 7\) intersect at:
(Lines \(y = 2x + 1\) aur \(y = -x + 7\) kahan milti hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(2x + 1 = -x + 7 \Rightarrow 3x = 6 \Rightarrow x = 2\), \(y = 5\). Dono lines \((2, 5)\) se guzarti hain.

book_ref.quote: The point of intersection of two linear functions is the point where their graphs cross each other.

blocks.prompt:
38 How many points of intersection do \(y = 4x + 1\) and \(y = 4x - 3\) have?
(\(y = 4x + 1\) aur \(y = 4x - 3\) ke kitne nuqta-e-taqatu hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik jaisa slope \(4\), mukhtalif intercepts: lines mutawazi (parallel). \(4x + 1 = 4x - 3\) se \(1 = -3\), na-mumkin.

book_ref.quote: This means the two functions have the same

blocks.prompt:
39 A table gives \(y = x + 2\): \(2, 3, 4\) and \(y = -x + 4\): \(4, 3, 2\) for \(x = 0, 1, 2\). The point of intersection is:
(Table mein \(x = 0, 1, 2\) ke liye \(y = x + 2\): \(2, 3, 4\) aur \(y = -x + 4\): \(4, 3, 2\). Nuqta-e-taqatu kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x = 1\) par dono columns \(3\) dete hain, is liye \((1, 3)\) dono lines par.

book_ref.quote: By plotting the above points, we see that

blocks.text: 2.2.3 Intersection of a Linear Function and a Quadratic Function

blocks.prompt:
40 A line and a parabola can intersect in at most:
(Line aur parabola zyada se zyada kitne nuqton par mil sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh do, aik ya kisi nuqte par nahi milte; mili hui equation quadratic hai jis ke zyada se zyada do real roots.

book_ref.quote: A line and a parabola can either intersect at two points, one point or not intersect at all.

blocks.prompt:
41 The vertex of the parabola \(y = x^{2} - 4x + 1\) is:
(Parabola \(y = x^{2} - 4x + 1\) ka vertex kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: The vertex \((h, k)\) of the parabola

blocks.prompt:
42 The line \(y = 2x - 1\) and the parabola \(y = x^{2}\) meet at:
(Line \(y = 2x - 1\) aur parabola \(y = x^{2}\) kahan milte hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} = 2x - 1 \Rightarrow (x - 1)^{2} = 0\): aik nuqta \((1, 1)\); line tangent (mamaas) hai.

book_ref.quote: suggesting that the line may be tangent to the parabola

blocks.prompt:
43 How many points do \(y = x\) and \(y = x^{2} + 2\) have in common?
(\(y = x\) aur \(y = x^{2} + 2\) ke kitne mushtarka nuqte hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} - x + 2 = 0\) ka discriminant \(1 - 8 = -7 < 0\): koi real root nahi, is liye koi taqatu nahi.

book_ref.quote: If no solution exists, it means the line and the parabola do not intersect.

blocks.prompt:
44 The points of intersection of \(y = x + 1\) and \(y = x^{2} - 1\) are:
(\(y = x + 1\) aur \(y = x^{2} - 1\) ke nuqta-e-taqatu kya hain?)

book_ref.quote: If there are two solutions, the system has two points of intersection.

blocks.prompt:
45 The \(x\)-intercepts of \(y = x^{2} - 4x + 1\) are at \(x =\)
(\(y = x^{2} - 4x + 1\) ke \(x\)-intercepts \(x =\))

book_ref.quote: Use the quadratic formula with

blocks.text: 2.3 Graph of the Square Root Function

blocks.prompt:
46 The domain of \(y = 3\sqrt{x} - 2\) is:
(\(y = 3\sqrt{x} - 2\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sqrt{x}\) sirf \(x \ge 0\) ke liye real hai; \(3\) aur \(-2\) is ko nahi badalte.

book_ref.quote: as the square root of a negative number is not a real number

blocks.prompt:
47 The range of \(y = 3\sqrt{x} - 2\) is:
(\(y = 3\sqrt{x} - 2\) ki range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sqrt{x} \ge 0 \Rightarrow 3\sqrt{x} - 2 \ge -2\), \(x = 0\) par.

book_ref.quote: Graph the square root function

blocks.prompt:
48 The graph of \(y = 2\sqrt{x} + 3\) starts at the point:
(\(y = 2\sqrt{x} + 3\) ka graph kis nuqte se shuru hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se chhota jaiz \(x = 0\): \(y = 2\sqrt{0} + 3 = 3\).

book_ref.quote: Table values and the graph of the function are given below:

blocks.prompt:
49 For \(y = 3\sqrt{x} + 1\), the value of \(y\) at \(x = 4\) is:
(\(y = 3\sqrt{x} + 1\) mein \(x = 4\) par \(y\) kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Plot the points of the table and join them with a smooth curve

blocks.prompt:
50 The domain of \(y = \sqrt{x - 2}\) is:
(\(y = \sqrt{x - 2}\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x - 2 \ge 0\) chahiye, yani \(x \ge 2\).

book_ref.quote: Clearly the domain of \(y = 2\sqrt{x} + 1\) is \(x \ge 0\)

blocks.text: 2.4 Graph of the Cube Root Function

blocks.prompt:
51 The domain of \(y = \sqrt[3]{x + 5}\) is:
(\(y = \sqrt[3]{x + 5}\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har real number (musbat, manfi ya sifar) ka cube root real hai, is liye har real x jaiz hai.

book_ref.quote: because the cube root of any number (positive, negative or zero) is always real

blocks.explanation: \((-3)^{3} = -27\), is liye \(\sqrt[3]{-27} = -3\); manfi numbers ke real cube roots hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The range of the given function is also the set of real numbers.

blocks.prompt:
53 The graph of \(y = \sqrt[3]{x + 2}\) crosses the \(x\)-axis at:
(\(y = \sqrt[3]{x + 2}\) ka graph \(x\)-axis ko kahan kaatta hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(y = 0 \Rightarrow x + 2 = 0 \Rightarrow x = -2\); \(\sqrt[3]{x}\) ka graph \(2\) units baen taraf.

book_ref.quote: Graph the cube root function

blocks.prompt:
54 For \(y = \sqrt[3]{x - 1}\), the value of \(y\) at \(x = 9\) is:
(\(y = \sqrt[3]{x - 1}\) mein \(x = 9\) par \(y\) kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: As we know that cube root function is defined for all real numbers

blocks.prompt:
55 Which of these is an example of decay?
(In mein se kaunsi decay (kami) ki misal hai?)

options.text: bank account mein sood (interest) kamane wali raqam
mahinon mein barhti khargoshon ki aabadi
radioactive maddah saalon mein taqat khota hai

blocks.explanation: Decay: waqt ke saath kam hoti miqdaar, maslan radioactive maddah ya thandi hoti coffee.

book_ref.quote: When something decreases in quantity or size over time, it is called decay.

blocks.prompt:
56 In \(P(t) = P_{0}e^{rt}\), the value at \(t = 0\) is:
(\(P(t) = P_{0}e^{rt}\) mein \(t = 0\) par qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(P(0) = P_{0}e^{0} = P_{0}\): shuru ki qeemat.

book_ref.quote: The value of a stock follows the exponential growth model

blocks.prompt:
57 A quantity grows as \(P(t) = P_{0}e^{0.07t}\). Its doubling time is about:
(Aik miqdaar \(P(t) = P_{0}e^{0.07t}\) ke mutabiq barhti hai. Is ka dugna hone ka waqt taqreeban:)

book_ref.quote: After how many years will the stock double in value?

blocks.prompt:
58 A stock worth Rs. 2,000 grows as \(P(t) = 2000e^{0.04t}\). After 5 years its value is about:
(Rs. 2,000 ka stock \(P(t) = 2000e^{0.04t}\) ke mutabiq barhta hai. 5 saal baad qeemat taqreeban:)

book_ref.quote: Find the value of the stock after 10 years.

blocks.prompt:
59 A concentration is \(C(t) = \frac{60}{\sqrt{t + 4}}\) ppm. \(C(5) =\)
(Concentration \(C(t) = \frac{60}{\sqrt{t + 4}}\) ppm hai. \(C(5)\) kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: The concentration of a pollutant in a lake

blocks.prompt:
60 For \(C(t) = \frac{60}{\sqrt{t + 4}}\), the concentration becomes exactly \(10\) ppm when \(t =\)
(\(C(t) = \frac{60}{\sqrt{t + 4}}\) mein concentration bilkul \(10\) ppm kab hoti hai, \(t =\))
blocks.explanation: \(\sqrt{t + 4} = 6 \Rightarrow t + 4 = 36 \Rightarrow t = 32\); is ke baad \(C\), \(10\) se kam.

book_ref.quote: After how many days will the concentration drop below 10 ppm?
